question: I'm putting together a review of our first credit card wave and need a profile of every client who was issued a credit card in 1994 (issue date falling in calendar year 1994). For each such client, please include: client id, gender, birth date, card type, age at card issue (the card's issue year minus the client's birth year), number of loans on their account, total amount borrowed, borrower classification, district name, district average salary, and their age rank within gender. Use these classifications: Young borrower if there's at least one loan on the account and age at card issue is under 30; Mature borrower if there's at least one loan and age at card issue is 30 or more; otherwise Non-borrower. The age rank within gender should be a standard competition rank - equal ages share a rank and the next rank is skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). Order the rows by client id.
gold_sql: WITH cohort AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, cd.type AS card_type, (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cd.issued) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_issue, d.account_id, di.A2 AS district_name, di.A11 AS district_avg_salary FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', cd.issued) = '1994' ) SELECT co.client_id, co.gender, co.birth_date, co.card_type, co.age_at_issue, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_borrowed, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 AND co.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_category, co.district_name, co.district_avg_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY co.gender ORDER BY co.age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender FROM cohort co LEFT JOIN loan l ON co.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY co.client_id, co.gender, co.birth_date, co.card_type, co.age_at_issue, co.district_name, co.district_avg_salary ORDER BY co.client_id

expected.sql: WITH cohort AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, cd.type AS card_type, (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cd.issued) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_issue, d.account_id, di.A2 AS district_name, di.A11 AS district_avg_salary FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', cd.issued) = '1994' ) SELECT co.client_id, co.gender, co.birth_date, co.card_type, co.age_at_issue, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_borrowed, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 AND co.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_category, co.district_name, co.district_avg_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY co.gender ORDER BY co.age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender FROM cohort co LEFT JOIN loan l ON co.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY co.client_id, co.gender, co.birth_date, co.card_type, co.age_at_issue, co.district_name, co.district_avg_salary ORDER BY co.client_id
